descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT TC-25 step 6; UAT 3.3 · “Repeat steps 2–5 in Nursing Home.”.

Approach · TC-25 Web & Phone Sync · S02 Nursing Home, both devices: the same loop (UAT step 6)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U6 Steps 2-5 (add, pre-round save, generate, delete) work the same in Nursing Home as in Hospital. (UAT TC-25 step 6; UAT TC-25; UAT 3.3) — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog
  • U2 A patient added on the phone appears on the computer in real time, with no refresh or re-entry. (UAT TC-25 step 2; UAT TC-25; TFA-94704 AC 5; TFA-94513 AC 11) — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog
  • U3 A pre-round note dictated and saved on the computer appears on the phone in real time, with no refresh, and can be continued on the phone without re-entering anything. (UAT TC-25 step 3; UAT TC-25; TFA-94513 AC 11; TFA-94704 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog
  • U4 A note generated on the phone appears on the computer in real time, with no refresh. (UAT TC-25 step 4; UAT TC-25; TFA-94704 AC 5; TFA-94513 AC 11) — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog
  • U5 A patient deleted on the computer disappears from the phone in real time. (UAT TC-25 step 5; UAT TC-25; TFA-94513 AC 18; TFA-94704 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given As S01, both devices on the Nursing Home list (Today's Visits)

When Phone adds 'QA Sync Resident'. Computer saves {snfResident}'s pre-round note while the phone has that chart open. Phone generates the visit note while the computer has Post-Round open. Computer deletes 'QA Sync Resident' if any control deletes a resident (removing it from Today's Visits is not a delete)

Then Each change shows on the other device without a refresh, as in Hospital, including the panels Save Note filled (gated on Q5)

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): As S01 per checkpoint, with 'Sign-in code' and 'Something went wrong' forbidden on every observing-device checkpoint and the panel check of cp4 gated on Q5. cp5 checks 'CBC' (from 'recheck CBC Friday'), a token the note carries as written; oracle.mjs mustContain has no alternatives, and 'standby' could come back as 'stand-by' or 'supervision'. …

Where it ran: dev; test method MULTI · Multi-device / multi-account; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S02 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-25.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 8b4be94 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-19T17:04:37Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: MULTI · Multi-device / multi-account; secondary: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
